verdict.rationale: The evidence shows automatic review of every pull request, organization-level settings inherited by all repositories, and policy enforcement across repositories. These are automation and configuration-inheritance features, not a documented way for a user or agent to run one action on many selected items at once, such as bulk-dismissing or bulk-applying findings, or bulk-labeling or bulk-re-reviewing PRs. Under the adjacent-feature rule, they earn no credit for this story.
